headline: Bird flu tightens egg supply; new freshness enzymes; EPS sourdough fixes gluten-free muffins
summary: A California bird flu outbreak hit 1.3 million laying hens before the holiday baking rush, so push egg-replacement solutions to US cake and sweet-goods customers now.
Newly promoted extended-freshness baking enzymes compete directly with Puratos anti-staling improvers; identify the supplier and benchmark the claims.
An EPS-producing Weissella cibaria sourdough gave gluten-free muffins near-wheat volume and softness, a clean-label route for Puratos gluten-free and sourdough ranges.
Spanish data show cakes supply 27.6% of sugar in shopping baskets and chocolate tops sugar and saturated fat, signalling where reformulation pressure will land.
Univar is expanding Roquette plant-protein distribution in North America, and low-antinutrient faba beans showed good breadmaking, both relevant to protein enrichment.

items.title: Functional Role of Weissella cibaria N4 Exopolysaccharides in Improving the Technological Properties of Gluten‐Free Muffins
items.summary: Turkish researchers fermented a rice-flour Type II sourdough with the exopolysaccharide-producing Weissella cibaria N4 and found in-situ EPS gave gluten-free muffins volume and softness close to a wheat control.
items.why: An EPS-producing sourdough culture is a clean-label texturiser for gluten-free cakes and breads, a fit for Puratos sourdough and gluten-free ranges.

items.title: Extended Freshness Baking Enzymes
items.summary: Trend Hunter spotlights newly launched baking enzymes marketed for extended freshness and shelf life.
items.why: Freshness-enzyme launches are direct competition for Puratos's anti-staling enzyme and improver portfolio; worth identifying the supplier and claims.

items.title: California bird flu outbreak hits 1.3 million laying hens ahead of holiday baking rush
items.summary: A bird flu outbreak in California has hit 1.3 million laying hens ahead of the holiday baking season, tightening egg supply.
items.why: Renewed egg shortages raise demand for egg-replacement and egg-reduction solutions in cakes and sweet goods, a sales opening for Puratos patisserie and bakery ranges.

items.title: Exploratory screening of faba bean germplasm for winter adaptation and seed quality in Northwestern Europe
items.summary: Belgian two-year field study of winter and spring faba bean lines found NIRS predicts protein and vicine/convicine, and several low-VC accessions gave competitive loaf volume at 10% wheat substitution.
items.why: Low-antinutrient faba flour with good breadmaking performance is a European protein-enrichment option for Puratos bakery ingredients.

items.title: Food composition database of products available on the Spanish market in 2022: A tool for the design, implementation and monitoring of policies to improve food environments
items.summary: The Spanish food agency's branded food composition database for 2022 shows cakes contribute 27.6% of sugar in the Spanish basket, and chocolate is among the highest in sugar and saturated fat.
items.why: Spain's reformulation policy will target cakes and chocolate first, so Puratos patisserie and chocolate customers there need sugar and fat reduction solutions.

items.title: Papaya and Roselle Seed Oils as Partial Shortening Replacers in Cupcakes: Implications for Lipid Quality, Oxidative Stability, and Microbiological Quality
items.summary: Egyptian researchers replaced up to 20% of shortening in cupcakes with papaya or roselle seed oil, lowering oxidation and microbial counts, though 20% roselle oil reduced some sensory scores.
items.why: Upcycled seed oils as partial shortening replacers point to fat-quality improvement and natural antioxidant routes for cake formulations.

items.title: Does Red 40 Cause Cancer? Food Dye Safety and Cancer Risk Explained
items.summary: Explainer on whether the synthetic dye Red 40 causes cancer, amid ongoing US scrutiny of petroleum-based food colours.
items.why: Consumer concern over Red 40 keeps pressure on US customers to move icings, decorations and coated confections to natural colours; Puratos can push its natural-colour alternatives.
